concept: Full-body concept art of a sea monster for a video game: a bulbous purple octopus-like creature standing upright on four thick tentacles, with two more long tentacles held out to the sides like arms. With the tentacle on its right side it firmly grips a rusty iron sword, raised away from its body. Large yellow eyes, wet glossy skin with suckers. Rig-ready pose: every tentacle clearly separated from the others, the sword held away from the body. Seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: purple octopus sea monster standing on four thick tentacles, two tentacles held out like arms, one tentacle gripping a rusty iron sword
garde: Keep the exact same creature: identical bulbous body, eyes, the same tentacles in the same pose, the same rusty iron sword gripped by the same tentacle, the same colours and glossy skin.
